notes.title: 《4 Rush Together》 1.0.3 Update Description
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have fixed and adjusted some issues with 《4 Rush Together》. The updated content is as follows:
[list]
[*] Added vertical synchronization settings.
[*] Added setting for lens rotation speed.
[*] Added a setting function button in the ESC menu.
[*] Adjusted the issue of not displaying rankings after clearing the local multiplayer mode.
[*] Adjusted the issue of only displaying one player in the 20th position of the cooperative mode ranking list.
[*] Fixed the issue of punching data statistics.
[*] Fixed the issue of frame drops in the game lobby.
[*] Optimized the issue of saving statistical data.
[/list]

notes.title: The DEMO version of "4 Rush Together" Update Notes for September 22, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The DEMO version of "4 Rush Together" has officially been released! You're welcome to try it out, and please note that the test version will soon be closed. In the DEMO version, you can experience brand-new levels. We've also updated our maps, adjusted the game difficulty based on your feedback, and fixed some known bugs.

Once again, thank you for playing our game! We hope it brings you a joyful and wonderful experience. Don't forget to invite your friends to join in, as playing together doubles the fun!

If you encounter any issues with the game, discover bugs, or have anything you'd like to say to us, please send an email to: support@hlzvr.com, or join our QQ group: 839240068.

Update Notes (September 22, 2024):

-Added more randomness to some level traps.
-Widened certain narrow platforms.
-Reduced the speed of large pendulums in some levels.
-Increased the animation time for certain platforms.
-Added a "Next Level" button.
